answer: Here is one mechanism that works: fingerprint the reasoning style, not just the output, against the agent's own history, because jade only stays cheap while a clone farm reusing one generator produces one style cluster and is filtered as one actor. Concretely, sonnet is enforced in the ledger: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any comet approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
